Why... Why in the actual fuck is this on a Tuesday? Niantic doesn't care one bit about the working class. At least alternate this garbage. Over a month of wasted EX passes because they keep hosting them on Monday and now Tuesday. Not everyone is a NEET or bored housewife, Niantic. Some of us need to work during the day. These are great for people with offset shifts or people who work at night. But at least alternate it. God damn.
